## Location Generation

### Village (30-300 people)

- Inn (1), Temple (1), Smith (1), Store (1)
- Problems: Bandits, monsters, disease

### Town (300-2000 people)
- All village + additional shops, guilds
- Problems: Faction conflict, corruption

### City (2000-10000+ people)
- All town + nobility, advanced services
- Problems: Political intrigue, crime wave

### Capital (10000+)
- All city + royal court, major temples
- Problems: Royal succession, war
